correctness.rationale: Conjugating each principal-axis plane reflection of a parallelotope via its SVD gives the Householder matrix I-2vv^T and containment factor its infinity-to-infinity norm. Row l1<=sqrt3, with equality iff the squared normal coordinates have one of two explicitly solved (t,s,s) radical patterns. An orthogonal pair of equality-type normals has a third normal with squares (0,1/2,1/2); hence no orthonormal equality triple, so some principal reflection is strict. Published polarity and complementary-dimension invariances extend from parallelotopes to cross-polytopes. The published 3D Banach--Mazur equality classification then excludes any other equality body. All strict assertions are pointwise, no compact uniform gap follows.
